config.rules: scarcity_urgency_pressure, reciprocity_obligation, platform_migration, safety_and_privacy_multiplier, financial_emergency_multiplier, confirmshaming_guilt_pressure

rule-detector-v1.description: Lexical rule-based baseline. Transparent but brittle. Used as the interpretable baseline for every other checkpoint.

config.labels: weak-supervised from rule-based detector + metadata cues

tfidf-ovr-v1.description: TF-IDF + OVR logistic regression. Existing v1 council model. Metrics are agreement-with-council, NOT independent validity.

config.scoring: rule-based signal inventories with saturating transform
config.composites: transparent summary only; no universal score

persuasive-profile-v1.description: 17-dimension persuasive profile. Per-dimension signal inventories are auditable. Composites are transparent summaries, not universal scores.

config.calibration: Platt scaling fitted on 400 pairs (200 pos, 200 neg); Brier=0.0034, ECE=0.0525

authorship-v1.description: Multi-signal authorship / common-source analysis. Length-aware abstention. NEVER names a person from similarity alone. Platt-calibrated on 400 pairs (Brier=0.0034).

config.detectors: creative_novelty, unusual_technique_combination, style_outlier, visual_outlier, performance_over/under, temporal, duplicate, extraction_error, metadata_error, model_error
config.performance_proxy: quality_score (corpus has no real performance metrics)

outlier-v1.description: 10+ outlier detectors. Every report carries comparison population, feature space, alternative explanation, and uncertainty.

config.spaces: persuasive, semantic, rhetorical, visual, multimodal, authorial, performance

clustering-v1.description: 7-space clustering with stability, leakage, and explanation reports.
